title: The Best Homecoming
author: Orsen Kavanagh
blurb: Tamsin Dravenmoor, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must save the tradition that made the town before the last game of the season.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
